summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K to disclose that Fitch Ratings upgraded certain issuer default and senior unsecured debt ratings of its subsidiaries (e.g., National Westminster Bank Plc, The Royal Bank of Scotland plc) to 'AA' from 'AA-' with a Stable outlook. This credit-rating-action disclosure is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation. No transactional terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are present. The filing merely informs the market of the rating change; there is no event to watch or risk-arb angle.
